name: allwinner_t113_outer_layer_signals
description: Fixed, common-model signal-routing projection of the Allwinner T113-S3 development board before fanout. This is a controlled routing workload, not fabrication data.

source.note: Saved intermediate SRJ used for direct fanout trials. The effective SRJ from the earlier 1,139-obstacle core failure was not captured; this fixture does not claim to reproduce that input.

projection.coordinateFrame: +X right, +Y up; board center at origin
transformations: Keep all 138 original multi-terminal signal/power point-to-point nets; omit 193 single-terminal plane-termination jobs. Net names are preserved.
Keep the original XY placement and board bounding rectangle; omit rounded outline and internal copper planes.
Map four-layer through pads to electrically connected top/bottom pads and expose both layers at their terminals.
Replace oval/circular copper and drill obstacles with bounding rectangles; swap width/height for the eight 90/270-degree rotated pads.
Reduce each signal pad connectedTo to its one requested net. Treat all 265 remaining obstacles as unrouted keepouts.
Use uniform 0.15 mm traces and copper clearance, 0.6 mm via pads and 0.3 mm drill; no blind/buried vias or via-in-pad.
Use no preloaded traces, special USB routing, differential pairs, bus constraints, net classes, planes, or fanout in either engine.
limitations: This two-layer projection differs from the four-layer manufactured-board intent and the earlier failed routing attempts.
Rectangular bounding approximations are conservative for oval/circular shapes and may make some fine-pitch escapes harder.
Benchmark geometry checks do not validate controlled impedance, signal integrity, power integrity, drill manufacturing rules or the actual published PCB.
The fixture is a single workload; results cannot establish overall router superiority.
